entities.summary: Malaʻekula is the name given to the royal burial grounds in central Nukuʻalofa in Tonga. The monarchs of Tonga and their immediate family are buried there. Extended family members are buried elsewhere, in other chiefly cemeteries. Kings from older times are mostly buried in the langi in Muʻa.
